title: 1850. Minimum Adjacent Swaps to Reach the Kth Smallest Number

examples.explanation: The 4th smallest wonderful number is "5489355421". To get this number: - Swap index 7 with index 8: "5489355142" -> "5489355412" - Swap index 8 with index 9: "5489355412" -> "5489355421"

The 4th smallest wonderful number is "21111". To get this number: - Swap index 3 with index 4: "11112" -> "11121" - Swap index 2 with index 3: "11121" -> "11211" - Swap index 1 with index 2: "11211" -> "12111" - Swap index 0 with index 1: "12111" -> "21111"
The 1st smallest wonderful number is "00132". To get this number: - Swap index 3 with index 4: "00123" -> "00132"
